newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Thursday amid thin buying interest, traders said.
"The sentiment is still bearish, as usual. There have been several bids this afternoon, but the levels are just too low for us to sell," said one trader in Medan, North Sumatra.

"Buyers bid between 42.00 U.S. cents/lb and 43.00 in Medan for September shipment, but nobody wants to sell as our ideal prices stay at 44.00. In general, the market is kind of losing direction," he added.
Traders said offer prices were generally stable at 43.50 fob Palembang, 43.75 fob Surabaya, 43.625 fob Padang, 43.25 fob Pontianak and 43.345 fob Jambi.

"We expect market sentiment to remain bearish tommorow, especially after what happened on the Thai baht on Wednesday. Buyers seem to be on the sidelines, waiting for fresh developments," said one trader.
Some traders said supply was quite good in the local market, making it possibile for prices to slide further.
